      "description": "A from-scratch, zero-dependency neural network engine (dense layers, backprop, SGD, tanh/relu/sigmoid) written in ~150 lines of plain JavaScript, with no libraries and no build step for the app itself.       "name": "Nebula — Barnes-Hut Galaxy Simulator",
      "description": "A real-time N-body gravity simulator running entirely in the browser (vanilla JS + Canvas2D, zero dependencies, zero build step, zero server required — just double-click index.html). Implements a genuine Barnes-Hut quadtree approximation algorithm (O(n log n) instead of O(n²)) so it can simulate hundreds of mutually-gravitating bodies at a steady 60fps — and lets you watch the actual quadtree subdivide live via a toggleable overlay (see screenshots in the README). Overlapping bodies merge through momentum-conserving accretion, so simulated galaxies visibly clump into fewer, bigger bodies over time. Includes a seeded procedural spiral-galaxy generator, a random cluster mode, and a binary-star system mode, plus interactive controls (body count, simulation speed, θ accuracy/performance tradeoff, trails, quadtree overlay, collision toggle, zoom, and click-drag to fling new bodies with realistic velocity). The physics core is a pure, dependency-free ES module (physics.mjs) shared conceptually with a classic-script build (physics.inline.js) for zero-setup browser use, validated by a 20-test Node suite (test.mjs) covering Newton's third law, Barnes-Hut vs brute-force accuracy, quadtree mass conservation, momentum conservation across 200 integration steps, orbital energy-drift bounds, quadtree bounds extraction, and collision-merge conservation laws.       "id": "proj_8f62b6d4c1a2",
      "name": "PyCrawler",
      "description": "A procedurally generated ASCII roguelike dungeon crawler in pure Python 3, zero runtime dependencies. Dungeons are built with real Binary Space Partitioning (BSP): rooms carved in leaf nodes of a randomly split tree, corridors carved along the tree so every room is guaranteed reachable (verified by a flood-fill test across 25 seeds). Turn-based combat, monsters that chase on sight, items (potions/weapons/scrolls), fog-of-war with explored-tile memory, multi-level descent to a win condition, permadeath. Ships with a BFS-pathfinding heuristic bot that can autoplay full games headlessly (fight-adjacent -> grab loot -> hunt visible monsters -> beeline for stairs -> flee when critical), which doubles as both a no-TTY demo mode for judges/CI and an automated playthrough test.
